links.scope: The model file list checks up to 2,000 entries across all folders it scans. The test confirmed that parent and child folders share this limit. The test also confirmed that the reader closes after a read error.
limitations: The limit and read-error tests used a simulated directory reader. Windows file protection for deleting or revealing model files still needs separate checks.

links.scope: Tests rejected extra bytes in a reply and output received while no request was active. They also checked that a reply can arrive in pieces and that the child process closes before the adapter can start a new session.
limitations: These tests used a simulated child process. The tests cannot show when the child wrote the bytes. Windows file protection for deleting or showing model files in their folder still needs separate tests.

links.scope: When the user asks to delete the files too, the application keeps the model record if it cannot confirm file deletion. Tests checked the refusal and confirmed that users can still remove only the model record.
limitations: The tests used a simulated file deletion result. Windows tests for deleting model files and opening their folder are still pending.

links.scope: Tests confirmed that saving a generated model keeps an existing snapshot intact. When two saves competed, one complete result remained. On Windows, a test confirmed that the app refused to save from a linked source folder.
limitations: A separate test could not create a file link inside the source folder, so that check is pending. Tests for model file ownership, file deletion and opening the model folder are still pending.

links.scope: When a mouse or touch action outside Notifications closes the panel, an outside control keeps focus if it has focus. Escape and Close return focus to the notification bell. A click on the page background also returns focus to the bell if no other control has focus.
limitations: The tests used a simulated page. Browser and desktop checks for this increment are still pending.

links.scope: A workspace change that closes Notifications returns focus to the bell. A pointer dismissal still leaves focus on a control outside the panel if that control already has focus.
limitations: These tests used a simulated page. Browser and desktop checks for the app remain pending.

links.scope: Model downloads keep their original organization, user and saved details while waiting for the runtime. The focused tests also covered list results and cancellation confirmation.
limitations: The tests used simulated runtime replies in one process. Registration recovery after restart and access to actual model files still need testing.

links.scope: The staging owner accepts seal, status and release requests only from the private lease it recorded. The tests refused copies and substitutes for that private lease and kept the original usable.
limitations: The tests used synthetic files and a simulated file service. The check applies to the private permit itself. Windows file protection, disk accounting, worker shutdown, restart and real offload measurements still need testing.

links.scope: The Settings and Functional tests skip the app's local environment files. Each test run uses its own cache and keeps the existing local API connection.
limitations: The checks verified test setup and did not run the app in Chrome or Electron. Those checks are still pending.

links.scope: If a website save response is lost, the app checks the saved records before it reports success. It keeps the files if the result is unclear. If the app finds that a website capture task has failed, it stops before the next page.
limitations: The tests used local sample files. Live website and private provider checks remain pending. Recovery for files from an unconfirmed save also remains pending.

links.scope: If the app still tracks a download and the runtime returns its task ID again, the app keeps the original owner. A new controller refuses stale task IDs and leaves saved model records unchanged.
limitations: The tests reopened a local sample registry. Recovery of an unfinished download after a process restart and Windows model file checks remain pending.

links.scope: The loader accepts only the original handle to seal, reuse or release its staging slot. Tests refused copies and refused a valid handle given another slot's details.
limitations: The tests used small sample files and a simulated file service. Windows protection, restart and real memory checks remain pending.

links.scope: The app refuses a copied handle before adding it to the cleanup list. A valid handle keeps the same tracked model references until cleanup finishes.
limitations: The tests used simulated interruptions and cleanup responses. Real offload restart and resource checks remain pending.

links.scope: If a second website capture reaches the same files, the app reports a conflict. The first capture can finish and save its original files.
limitations: The tests used local sample data. The live website and recovery checks still need evidence.

links.scope: When a website refresh finds a change, the app checks that the old and new versions have different IDs and belong to the same source. The app saves the result and new version together.
limitations: The tests used sample records. Live provider checks and the order of concurrent refreshes still need evidence.

links.scope: The UI test inventory now points to the reviewed website capture regression. The inventory still maps 39 scenarios to 131 expected behaviors.
limitations: The inventory check read the test definitions. Browser, Desktop and full application results remain separate.

links.scope: The app keeps the model record when it cannot confirm cleanup of the related artifact records. The result lists only records the catalog confirms it removed.
limitations: The tests used sample records. Windows model file deletion, opening a model folder, and real catalog cleanup still need separate checks.

links.scope: The app limits the number of folders, files, and bytes it scans before saving a generated model. It also limits folder depth and checks the copied files before putting them in the model cache.
limitations: The tests used sample files and Windows folder junctions. File replacement during saving, protected ownership, deleting model files, and opening model folders still need separate checks.

links.scope: If versions of the same source share a capture time, the app prefers a version with no recorded replacement at that time. The stored versions stay available as history.
limitations: The tests used sample records. Live website behavior and the order of concurrent refreshes still need separate checks.

links.scope: After the app confirms cleanup for a low-memory run, it rejects later requests for that run and keeps it closed.
limitations: The tests used simulated cleanup and worker exit. Protected restart and actual low-memory measurements still need separate checks.

links.scope: When saving a generated model, the app copies only the number of bytes it checked for each file. If the app detects a file change during the copy, it rejects the save.
limitations: The tests used local sample files. Two Windows link checks were skipped. Windows tests for simultaneous file changes are still pending. Protected ownership, file deletion, and opening model folders still need separate checks.

links.scope: A low-memory run keeps its slot until cleanup is confirmed. If a cleanup result is lost or uncertain, the app keeps the slot reserved.
limitations: The tests simulated cleanup and interruptions. A protected Windows restart and real low-memory measurements still need separate checks.

links.scope: An upload chunk that exceeds the remaining file size leaves saved progress unchanged. The next correctly sized chunk can complete the upload.
limitations: The tests used sample files with real local storage. A live website and a private provider still need separate checks.

links.scope: The app checks the worker's training start reply against the requested run and workspace. A conflicting start cannot replace a tracked run.
limitations: The tests used sample replies from a simulated worker. Checks for actual worker runs and protected Windows file ownership remain pending.

links.scope: The app assigns an output folder to each training run. It verifies that folder before offering a review, saving output, or cleaning up a confirmed run.
limitations: The tests used a simulated worker and sample files. Checks for simultaneous Windows file changes and protected model file actions remain pending.

links.scope: When two files in one upload task advance together, both progress updates can be saved. The retry reuses the bytes already saved. Cancellation still takes precedence.
limitations: The tests used sample files with real local storage. Checks for shared hosts, a live website, and a private provider remain pending.

links.scope: If the app detects that upload bytes arrived after cancellation, it marks their checkpoint for cleanup. A failed cleanup can be retried after the database reopens.
limitations: The tests used sample files and local storage. Recovery from a crash before a write returns and live provider checks remain pending.

links.scope: After the low-memory accounting journal confirms cleanup, a late request cannot reopen it. An interrupted removal keeps the record reserved.
limitations: The tests simulated cleanup and interruptions. Protected Windows restart and real low-memory measurements remain pending.

links.scope: After the app confirms worker cleanup, a late failure report leaves the finished run closed. If removal of the ownership record is interrupted, the app keeps that record.
limitations: The tests simulated worker cleanup and interruptions. Protected Windows staging, accounting, restart and real offload measurements remain pending.

links.scope: Each test phase counts preparation and execution against one time limit. The normal wait for child processes shares that limit. Cleanup keeps its separate time limits.
limitations: This earlier source checkpoint used simulated checks. A separate later run passed nine fixed Windows process checks. Overall runner and app qualification remain pending.

links.scope: The native runner refuses a new test when its stop marker exists, including a broken link. An access error also refuses the new test.
limitations: That earlier Windows run produced the expected output and confirmed cleanup, but failed its process-count check. Its failed history remains unchanged. A later reviewed run passed the fixed Windows process checks.

links.scope: Harmless native test children use the original Python interpreter. The fixed roles, limits and failed history are preserved.
limitations: This receipt covers 75 simulated source checks. Later reviewed source and controlled Windows tests are recorded separately. No user action is needed for the already approved retry.

links.scope: Upload data is copied before storage waits. The tests verify stable saved bytes, matching retries and a copy that fits its checked size.
limitations: The file tests used temporary local data. The remaining provider browser check, larger-file and crash-recovery qualification are still pending.

links.scope: Test planning uses all four registered model checks and all four registered notification checks. Uncovered files still keep their broader verification requirement.
limitations: These results cover test planning and the upload correction. Real app journeys and final combined coverage remain pending.
